name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when buying a rental property for the first time?

mainEntity.name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when buying a rental property for the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text: First-time rental property buyers should avoid underestimating operating expenses, overestimating rental income, and neglecting thorough property inspections. Another common pitfall is not understanding local landlord-tenant laws, which can vary across counties like Miami-Dade and Broward. It's crucial to have a clear financial analysis and understand the responsibilities of being a landlord before purchasing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid underestimating expenses, overestimating income, skipping inspections, and neglecting local landlord-tenant laws.
